title: "02_expression_clean"
format: html
---

##Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(here)
library(hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db) 
library(tidyverse)                     

expr_clean <- read_tsv(here("data/01_expression_load.tsv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE)
```

##Drop NAs and duplicates
```{r}
# Change ID column name
expr_clean <- expr_clean |> 
  dplyr::rename(probeID = 1)

#Drop NAs and duplicates
dim(expr_clean)

expr_clean <- expr_clean |> 
  mutate(probeID = as.character(probeID)) |> 
  distinct(probeID, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  drop_na()

dim(expr_clean)
```
As we can see no NAs or duplicates existed in the data frame

##Map probeIDs to ENTREZ IDs

We need to map each of the probe IDs to ENTREZ IDs. To do that we first create a tibble with the ENTREZ IDs and then we join that tibble with the expr data frame. The microarray used Affymetrix Human Gene 1.0 ST Array (HuGene-1_0-st), so we look up into the corresponding annotation package.

```{r}
#| message: false
# Query chip's annotation package
probe_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db,  
  keys = expr_clean |> pull(probeID) |> as.character(),         
  columns = c("ENTREZID","SYMBOL"),
  keytype = "PROBEID"              
) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  dplyr::rename(probeID = PROBEID, ENTREZ_ID = ENTREZID) |>  #dplyr::because it would use base::rename instead and won't work
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZ_ID)) |> 
  distinct(probeID, .keep_all = TRUE) 

```

```{r}
# Count how many probes mapped to each gene before collapsing
probe_collapse_summary <- probe_map |>
  count(ENTREZ_ID, SYMBOL, name = "n_probes") |>  #count the number of rows of probes per unique gene 
  count(n_probes, name = "n_genes") |> #count the occurrences of the same number of probes per gene
  mutate(
    total_probes = n_probes * n_genes
  )

probe_collapse_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n_probes, weight = n_genes)) +
  geom_density(fill = "gray", alpha = 0.5, color = "black", bw = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Density of Probes Mapped per Gene",
    x = "Number of Probes per Gene",
    y = "Density"
  ) 

probe_collapse_summary
```
As we can see the majority of genes (18784) are covered by only one probe, and the number of genes with n number of probes drops exponentially as n increases.  

##Join ENTREZ IDs data frame to expr data frame
```{r}
# Join ENTREZ IDs to expression data and collapse probe duplicates to ENTREZ IDs by averaging the values
expr_clean <- expr_clean|> 
  inner_join(probe_map, by = "probeID") |> 
  dplyr::select(-probeID) |> 
  group_by(ENTREZ_ID, SYMBOL) |> 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean), .groups = "drop")
  
dim(expr_clean)
expr_clean |> 
  dplyr::select(1:6) |> 
  glimpse()
```

##Save the expr_clean to a tsv file
```{r}
write_tsv(expr_clean, here("data/02_clean_expression.tsv"))
```
